original_heading: The Lord Trusts Us to Sow Good Seed for a Good Harvest, August 17
verse: The kingdom of heaven may be compared to someone who sowed good seed in his field; but while everybody was asleep, an enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and then went away. Matthew 13:24, 25, NRSV.
title: Guarding the Harvest: Discernment in God's Work
bullets: God entrusts His work only to those who know His Word deeply and understand the mysteries of His kingdom, not to those ignorant of Scripture.
Satan works secretly to corrupt the church with false converts and evil associations, disguising himself as an angel of light to deceive even the faithful.
We must remain vigilant to separate true wheat from counterfeit tares, allowing no tolerance for evil workers or corrupting influences in our Christian fellowship.

hymn.title: Break Thou the Bread of Life

prayer: Lord, help me know Your Word so deeply that I can discern truth from deception in my own heart and in the church around me. Give me courage to stand against corruption and to sow only good seed in Your kingdom's harvest.
